description: العربية/Arabic Matrix Table Convergent Business Technologies · Free · All features included العربية Arabic Matrix is designed specifically for Arabic and Right-to-Left reporting. The visual enables clear comparison of hierarchical data across rows and columns while fully supporting Arabic layouts, number units, and labeling. It integrates seamlessly with Power BI, offering subtotals, grand totals, cross-filtering, drill-down, tooltips, and flexible customization — making it ideal for financial, operational, and KPI analysis in Arabic dashboards. Key Capabilities Right-to-Left Arrangement & Aggregation — Full RTL arrangement and aggregation across all table elements and labels. Arabic Data Labels & Number Units — Native Arabic number units: thousands, millions, and billions in Arabic script. Row & Column Hierarchies with Drill-Down — Navigate hierarchical data across both rows and columns with full drill-down support. Subtotals & Grand Totals — Automatically calculated subtotals and grand totals for rows and columns. Cross Filtration — Full Power BI cross-filtering; click any cell to filter related visuals. Tooltips — Rich hover tooltips for detailed data insight on any cell. Customization Settings — Extensive formatting pane for colours, fonts, spacing, and label control.
